svg.title: Tank-G front panel mapped to openvave fields
svg.desc: The fifteen knobs of the Tank-G in panel order, left to right: master, IR cab, reverb mix, reverb decay, delay time, delay mix, mod speed, mod fx, volume, bass, middle, treble, gain, amp type, noise gate, each with its openvave field and preset byte, coloured like the knob LEDs. Below, the four footswitches A/REVERB, B/DELAY, C/MOD, D/AMP.
svg.text: Knobs in panel order, left to right, coloured like their LEDs. Read right to left, they follow preset bytes 4 → 17.
preset slot A of the bank
preset slot B of the bank
preset slot C of the bank
preset slot D of the bank
Footswitch roles are read from the panel labels: a slot letter and an effect block. openvave has not mapped presses one by one.
Panel combos: A+B = BANK −, C+D = BANK +, B+C = LIVE / PRESET, hold B+C = TUNER / BT (as printed; not tested with openvave).
MASTER: no preset byte found (it was not in the mapping sessions); probably an output level outside the preset, untested.
Original drawing for openvave (MIT), traced from the owner's pedal; not a vendor image.
